_comment: The one list of what can be previewed in-app, asserted by three test suites so the copies cannot drift: packages/app (lib/attachmentCapability.test.ts), services/messaging-svc (internal/media/preview_test.go) and services/doc-converter (tests/test_spec.py). `preview` maps an extension to the artifact the sandbox produces: pdf (Word, PowerPoint) or sheet (Excel). Everything in `notPreviewable` must be download-only.
